# Third-Party Notice

This project bundles a GB2312 subset of **Fusion Pixel Font** (12px proportional, Simplified Chinese),
generated into `hevi/layer4_legacy/artmotion/omodul_impl/scripts/engine/lib/fonts/FusionPixel12-400.woff`.

Used by the `14_8bit` (8-bit pixel) art-motion style so on-screen numbers and CJK text stay readable
after pixelation (r6 B2).

- Upstream: https://github.com/TakWolf/fusion-pixel-font
- Version: 2026.09.25
- License: SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1 (see `OFL.txt` in this directory)
- Copyright (c) 2022, TakWolf (https://takwolf.com)

The subset was produced locally with `hevi/layer4_legacy/artmotion/omodul_impl/scripts/font_subset.py`
(GB2312 coverage + the task's own glyphs). The OFL permits bundling and redistribution of derived
font software under the same license.
